caseNameFull: United States v. Colotta, doing business as Long & Chambless Plumbing & Heating Co.
attorneys: Solicitor General Sobelojf, Assistant Attorney General Holland, Marvin E. Frankel, Ellis N. Slack, A. F. Prescott and Fred E. Youngmah for the United States.

opinions.text:
On petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Mississippi.

Per Curiam:

The petition for writ of certiorari in this case is granted and the judgment is reversed.

Mr. Justice Douglas dissents.
